caveat: The historical number comes from data/final_studies/, a split grouped by claim only. The Phase 1 audit measured 57.2% of its source_binary_test rows reusing evidence text seen verbatim in training (84.7% train-majority-label agreement on that shared evidence), so the historical figure may be inflated by an evidence-side shortcut rather than reflecting claim understanding. The clean figure is measured on a split with zero claim, evidence, and claim-evidence-pair overlap (see leakage_check_results.json). Any drop from historical to clean is consistent with — not proof of — the leakage hypothesis; other differences (different exact row set, different component sizes after grouping) also contribute.
